semantic_units.text: The Sensor-Hub block serves to operate the Sensor Hub I2C master for external targets, including trigger/control, pad enable, data collection, and FIFO multi-mode coordination.
The Sensor-Hub block accepts Primary sensing input.
The Sensor-Hub block produces Analog input signal.
The last 8-bits of the data stored in FIFO contains the TAG field.
SLAVEx NUMOP bit-fields of SLAVEx CONFIG registers defines how many bytes per slave are read as per effect of an I2C operation (x from 1 to 12).
The output port sleep master is set to 1 when an I2C operation is not on-going.
Only I2C target addressed through SLAVE0 DEV ADD register is the destination of an I2C Write Operation.
Each data stored in FIFO is composed by 4 words (16bytes).
All the SENSOR HUB x registers is reset every time a new I2C operation starts.
3 words (12bytes) of the data stored in FIFO contains the data from each I2C slave.
24-bits of the data stored in FIFO is reserved at '0'.
When Quokka MasterBlaze µP runs (sleep master signal = 0), any dvalid triggered (HW or SW) is ignored.
The trigger of sensor hub is possible in both ways, HW via dvalid masterblaze ext signal or SW using DVALID REGISTER.
SLAVE0 NUMOP bitfield is ignored if an I2C Write operation is issued to the I2C Slave 0.
All the values from 1 to 12 is valid for SLAVEx NUMOP bit-fields of SLAVEx CONFIG registers.
The AHB Write to registers has no effect if the IP masterblaze processor is busy (I2C operation on-going); the registers value is not updated.
